result.summary: The page appears to be a well-designed food delivery app interface. There are no critical issues, but there are a few minor visual inconsistencies and potential improvements.

issues.description: The 'See all' links for 'Fastest near you' and 'Popular right now' sections are right-aligned, but the section headers are left-aligned, creating a slightly disconnected feel.
issues.suggestion: Consider aligning the 'See all' links closer to the headers or using a more consistent layout pattern for section headers and their actions.

issues.description: The 'Order now' button on the green promotional banner has a white background and green text, which might not stand out enough against the green background of the banner itself.
issues.suggestion: Consider using a higher contrast color for the button, or adding a subtle border/shadow to make it pop more from the banner background.

issues.description: The restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol...' is truncated in the 'Fastest near you' section.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the text container is wide enough to display the full name, or use an ellipsis consistently if truncation is intended, perhaps with a tooltip on hover/long-press.
